action_summary: Removed all six destructive fold-model deletion commands, restoring the complete saved BiEncoder fold ensemble used by v16, whose recorded score was 0.38513 versus v17 at 0.37427. Kept sigmoid averaging because its recorded BiEncoder score exceeded rank averaging. Preserved the Kaggle paths, checkpoint, batch size, notebook cell structure, and submission pipeline. The planning block was applied once: prioritize recovery of the existing fold ensemble; defer new backbones, loss changes, OOF stacking, and training without data or validation evidence. No training or inference was run; recovery of the historical score is plausible but not measured in this environment.
